title: Endpoint intrinsic ACCESS-BARRIER persistence over a window ladder, with a class-conditional static-denylist validity horizon
question: On the frozen 57-endpoint credential-free HTTP GET pool (inherited verbatim from EXP-PHYSICS-37992957068; NOT extended because the pre-freeze attainability certificate is satisfied inside the frozen 57), is an endpoint's INTRINSIC access-barrier state STATIONARY across separated ambient observation windows? Concretely: (Q1) across a window ladder anchored at T0 with nominal revisits at +300 s, +900 s and +1800 s, do the intrinsic classes {BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR} persist at an endpoint (CLASS_PERSISTENCE per present intrinsic class >= 0.80), and is the anchor-to-lag barrier-state identity transfer I(B_0;B_delta) distinguishable from an exchangeable/constant memory null? (Q2) does a static endpoint-level denylist built over the intrinsic (persistent) barrier classes at T retain validity at T+delta (false-accept = a denylisted intrinsic endpoint is non-intrinsic at T+delta; false-reject = a non-intrinsic endpoint becomes intrinsic), i.e. what is its measured validity horizon? (Q3, class-conditional) is the rate-driven class RATE_LIMIT_429 transient (induced recovery/onset within seconds-to-minutes) while the intrinsic classes persist, so that the product needs a class-conditional policy? The source-vantage axis is NOT varied and is a declared scope boundary. This is not next-request barrier classification (bounded by EXP-PHYSICS-37992957068), not C-FRESHNESS, and not Runtime drift.

hypothesis.H1_stationary: On this frozen pool/window the intrinsic access-barrier state is stationary at the tested timescales: every intrinsic class present at the anchor T0 has CLASS_PERSISTENCE >= 0.80 at the reference rung delta_ref=1800 s, the anchor-to-reference intrinsic denylist is valid (no false-accept and no false-reject above 0.20), and the anchor->lag barrier indicator carries information beyond the exchangeable constant null (STATIONARITY_SKILL >= 0.05 nats, permutation p < 0.05, clustered CI lower > 0). Product consequence: a static intrinsic denylist measured at one window remains valid for at least the tested horizon.
hypothesis.H0_nonstationary: The intrinsic access-barrier state is NOT stationary at the tested timescales: some intrinsic class present at T0 has CLASS_PERSISTENCE < 0.80 at delta_ref, OR the anchor-to-reference intrinsic denylist is invalid (FALSE_ACCEPT > 0.20 or FALSE_REJECT > 0.20), OR the anchor->lag barrier indicator is no better than the exchangeable constant null (STATIONARITY_SKILL < 0.05 or permutation p >= 0.05). Positive change evidence is thereby present; a static denylist is not amortizable through delta_ref on this pool.
hypothesis.H2_class_conditional: The intrinsic classes (BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR) persist while RATE_LIMIT_429 is transient: within the induced-transience probe, load-induced 429 endpoints recover to non-429 within the recovery ladder, and/or ambient 429 events appear and clear. This is a class-conditional refinement of whichever primary disposition holds; it licenses a class-conditional dead-end policy rather than a single pooled one.
hypothesis.H_null: B_EXCHANGE: the lag barrier indicator is independent of the anchor barrier indicator beyond its marginal (exchangeable endpoints), so STATIONARITY_SKILL ~ 0 and an anchor-built denylist is no better than the no-denylist constant prior. This null is calibrated before freeze with demonstrated power (see PC) and a false-positive bound (see NC).
hypothesis.relation_to_claim: H1/H0/H2 are orthogonal falsifiable programs on the C-WEB-DYNAMICS next_gate axis 'timescales'. H0/H2 bound (do not reject) a pooled static-denylist prior on this frozen pool/window and one network vantage. No hypothesis advances C-WEB-DYNAMICS above HYPOTHESIS.

falsifier: TWO-SIDED AND FROZEN; both directions are reachable through the frozen metric and branch logic (verified by pre-freeze offline calibration on synthetic worlds with the exact statistic and thresholds; see prereg.md 'Null calibration and branch reachability'). Frozen thresholds: delta_ref_s = 1800; intrinsic_persistence_min = 0.80; tau_FA = tau_FR = 0.20; alpha = 0.05; delta_SKILL_nats = 0.05; pc_power_min = 0.80; nc_false_positive_max = 0.05; min_t0_intrinsic = 3; min_t0_barrier = 3. Definitions: CLASS_PERSISTENCE[c] = fraction of endpoints whose ambient class at T0 equals intrinsic class c and whose ambient class at delta_ref is also c. INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT = (n_t0_intrinsic >= 3) AND (for every intrinsic class c present at T0: CLASS_PERSISTENCE[c] >= 0.80). DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT = |{T0 intrinsic, non-intrinsic at delta_ref}| / |T0 intrinsic|. DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT = |{T0 non-intrinsic, intrinsic at delta_ref}| / |T0 non-intrinsic|. DENYLIST_INTRINSIC_VALID = (FALSE_ACCEPT <= 0.20) AND (FALSE_REJECT <= 0.20). STATIONARITY_SKILL = plug-in mutual information I(B_T0; B_delta_ref) in nats over the binary barrier indicator. STAT_SIG = (STATIONARITY_SKILL >= 0.05) AND (B_EXCHANGE permutation p < 0.05) AND (endpoint-clustered bootstrap CI lower > 0). S1_STATIONARY iff INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT AND DENYLIST_INTRINSIC_VALID AND STAT_SIG. S0_NON_STATIONARY iff the measurement is valid and NOT S1_STATIONARY; the frozen S0 evidence classes are (a) INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT false (a durable intrinsic barrier changed class), (b) DENYLIST_INTRINSIC_VALID false (denylisted endpoint recovered, or a clean endpoint newly and durably blocked), and (c) STAT_SIG false (anchor->lag barrier information is no better than the exchangeable constant null). MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reserved exclusively for prerequisite/control failure and MUST NOT be used for a scientific S0. Pre-freeze synthetic calibration: S1 selected in 295/300 planted-stationary replications (per-class persistence rho=0.98) and 263/300 at rho=0.92; S0 selected in 300/300 intrinsic-break replications and 300/300 exchangeable replications; the full STAT_SIG was reached in 300/300 PC98 and 2/300 exchangeable replications (NC false-positive 0.0067 <= 0.05). Both directions are therefore arithmetically reachable.

B_EXCHANGE.description: Mandated memory/constant null: a GLOBAL uniform permutation of the lag barrier indicator B_delta_ref across all 57 endpoints (10000 permutations, seed 38074818597), preserving both marginals, recomputing I(B_T0; B_delta_ref) each time. This is the null that the anchor state carries no information about the lag state beyond its marginal (exchangeable / constant-marginal endpoints).

B_CONSTANT_USABLE.description: No-denylist baseline: predict non-barrier for every endpoint at every rung. Reference for the secondary denylist log-loss improvement.

B_MARGINAL.description: Predict the lag class from the lag-period marginal class frequency (constant-marginal null).

B_LASTSWEEP.description: Predict the next rung's barrier indicator from the immediately preceding rung rather than from the anchor.

baselines.comparison: STATIONARITY_SKILL is tested against B_EXCHANGE. The denylist decision is compared with B_CONSTANT_USABLE. B_MARGINAL and B_LASTSWEEP are reported diagnostics only.

PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY.description: Offline planted-stationary generator on the pilot marginal (46 CLEAN, 5 BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, 1 TRANSPORT_ERROR, 5 OTHER_NONBARRIER): the lag class equals the anchor class with probability rho, else is redrawn from the marginal. The SAME plug-in binary-barrier MI + B_EXCHANGE permutation test and the exact per-class persistence rule are applied.
PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY.power_requirement: Fraction of replications selecting S1_STATIONARY must be >= 0.80 at rho=0.98 and reported at rho=0.92.
PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY.construct_boundary: Validates that the estimator and branch logic recover a known stationary endpoint population at n=57; it does not assert that any real endpoint is stationary.

PC_ORACLE_BARRIER.description: Live positive control on non-pool hosts with deterministic status: https://httpbin.org/status/429 and redundant https://httpbingo.org/status/429 must classify RATE_LIMIT_429; https://no-such-host.invalid/ must classify TRANSPORT_ERROR; https://httpbin.org/status/403 must classify UNAVAILABLE_403 (proving 403-as-plain is not read as a challenge block). If both 429 oracles are unreachable/challenged the run is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
PC_ORACLE_BARRIER.pass_condition: Every oracle request classified into its expected class; otherwise MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
PC_ORACLE_BARRIER.construct_boundary: Confirms the live collection+classifier path registers barriers and separates 403-as-block from 403-as-plain; not a natural Web barrier.

NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE.description: Offline exchangeable generator: anchor and lag states drawn independently from the same marginal (equal to the observed anchor marginal); the SAME estimator and permutation test are applied.
NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE.pass_condition: Fraction of R replications with B_EXCHANGE permutation p < 0.05 must be <= 0.05.
NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE.construct_boundary: A genuinely exchangeable endpoint population must not yield spurious stationarity skill.

NC_CLEAN_ORACLE.description: Live negative control on https://httpbin.org/status/200, https://httpbin.org/uuid and https://example.com/, which must classify CLEAN.
NC_CLEAN_ORACLE.pass_condition: All requests classify CLEAN; otherwise MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
NC_CLEAN_ORACLE.construct_boundary: Confirms the classifier does not fire on clean responses.

C_PROBE_SELF_INDUCTION.description: Validity control for self-induction, NOT a statistical null: ambient barrier prevalence across the ladder rungs for the 52 non-stress endpoints, plus STATIONARITY_SKILL_NO_STRESS measured on those 52. A trend whose clustered CI excludes 0, or a large full-vs-no-stress gap, is disclosed as a self-induction caveat.
C_PROBE_SELF_INDUCTION.pass_condition: No hard pass/fail; reported transparently in result.json.
C_PROBE_SELF_INDUCTION.construct_boundary: Detects whether the repeated-probing protocol itself changes ambient barrier prevalence.

measurement_validity.target_integrity: Every request stores raw HTTP status, response headers (server, cf-mitigated, retry-after), body SHA-256, body byte length, elapsed ms, and any transport error string. Classification is a pure deterministic function of those stored fields, so AUDIT can recompute the class exactly.
measurement_validity.split_integrity: The anchor T0 and all rungs are independent observations of the SAME endpoints; there is no train/test split. All primary metrics are closed-form functions of the per-endpoint class sequence. Sampling order within a sweep is a frozen seeded permutation and does not depend on outcomes.
measurement_validity.sampling_integrity: The 57-endpoint universe is frozen and may not be substituted, added to, or dropped. Per-sweep probe order is a seeded permutation (seed 38074818597). No endpoint may be dropped after seeing its outcomes.
measurement_validity.uncertainty_integrity: Endpoint-permutation null: 10000 GLOBAL uniform shuffles of the lag barrier indicator across all 57 endpoints (seed 38074818597). Endpoint-clustered bootstrap: cluster = registrable_domain (URL host with one leading 'www.' stripped and the final two dot-separated labels retained; no multi-label public suffix occurs in the frozen 57); 10000 resamples (seed 38074818597), percentile 95% CIs.
measurement_validity.representation_integrity: One stdlib-HTTP client (Python 3.12 standard library ONLY; numpy is NOT required or imported), one User-Agent, one network egress vantage, one continuous ~45-minute wall-clock session. The source-vantage axis is NOT varied and is a declared scope boundary; results describe this pool, this vantage and this window only.
measurement_validity.control_integrity: PC_SYNTHETIC_STATIONARY power (permutation significance under planted persistence) must be >= 0.80; NC_SYNTHETIC_EXCHANGEABLE false-positive must be <= 0.05; PC_ORACLE_BARRIER and NC_CLEAN_ORACLE live classifications must be correct. Any failure => status MEASUREMENT_INVALID, never a scientific negative.
measurement_validity.prerequisite_integrity: Live network must reach the frozen universe and both oracle host groups. At T0 the number of ambient intrinsic endpoints must be >= 3 and the number of ambient barrier endpoints must be >= 3; the anchor sweep and the delta_ref=1800 s rung must both complete. The induced-transience probe (Q3) is a SECONDARY diagnostic: if it yields no load-induced RATE_LIMIT_429 endpoint, CLASS_CONDITIONAL_TRANSIENCE is reported as unmeasured (False) and the primary S1/S0 decision is unaffected, because the pre-freeze attainability certificate already proved a load-inducible rate-limit endpoint exists on the frozen stratum. Any shortfall in the listed prerequisites => MEASUREMENT_INVALID (attainability failure).
measurement_validity.power_integrity: Detection power at the observed T0 intrinsic class counts is REPORTED (POWER_AT_RHO98, POWER_AT_RHO92) using the frozen calibration; it is not a gate. No branch depends on a non-significant negative being read as falsification: S0 requires one of the three enumerated positive change classes.
measurement_validity.activity_disclosure: The only pre-freeze activity is non-outcome-bearing and DESIGN-local: (i) a reachability census on the full frozen 57 in two cold-GET sweeps ~132 s apart plus an 8-GET burst on the 5 stress endpoints followed by cold recovery probes, establishing attainability and classifier liveness (script sha256 c100f177..., output sha256 b0b9e520...); (ii) offline estimator/PC/NC calibration and branch-reachability runs on synthetic worlds implementing the EXACT frozen rule including the clustered-bootstrap CI-lower clause (script /tmp/opencode/phys380/calibrate4.py sha256 3e603e32f0b62e8790fb9927c040175236e44ecff0e0d145e65786ef46426cac, output cal4.json sha256 5fd08d9930ab1f1c1b5fe54a36c3fd86286bb1b9327ddef198363dfd11c2bed7). These establish attainability, calibration and branch reachability only. EXECUTE must re-verify all floors and controls from its own data; the raw probe artifacts are DESIGN-local (/tmp) and are NOT interpretation dependencies.

frozen_intrinsic_classifier.CHALLENGE_RE_LITERAL: (?i)(just a moment|cf-browser-verification|cf[-_]chl[-_]|challenge-platform|cf-challenge|cdn-cgi/challenge|attention required|checking your browser|enable javascript and cookies|verify you are human|please complete the security check|g-recaptcha|hcaptcha|recaptcha|cf-turnstile|<title>\s*just a moment)
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.match_scope: CHALLENGE_RE is applied to the first 262144 bytes of the response body decoded as utf-8 with errors ignored. cf-mitigated is lowercased and compared to the string 'challenge'.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.CLEAN: HTTP status in 200..299 (2xx) AND body does not match CHALLENGE_RE.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE: HTTP status == 403 AND (lowercase(cf-mitigated) == 'challenge' OR body matches CHALLENGE_RE).
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.UNAVAILABLE_403: HTTP status == 403 without any challenge marker.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.TRANSPORT_ERROR: No HTTP response (DNS failure, connection refused, TLS failure, or timeout).
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.OTHER_NONBARRIER: Any other HTTP status (404, 500, redirect chains to error) OR a 2xx carrying a challenge marker.
frozen_intrinsic_classifier.label_determinism: All classes are functions of a single request's stored fields only; none depends on prior requests.

frozen_universe.source: verbatim endpoints of EXP-PHYSICS-37992957068 (inherited from EXP-PHYSICS-37973239386); used unchanged. EXECUTE may not substitute, add to, or drop endpoints.

sweep_protocol.ambient_probe: For EVERY endpoint: a fresh cookie jar, then exactly ONE HTTP GET; store raw fields; ambient_class = frozen classifier output. Endpoints are probed sequentially in a per-sweep frozen seeded permutation order (seed 38074818597) with inter-endpoint gap 0.30 s.
sweep_protocol.ambient_probe_state: The PRIMARY state for all stationarity and denylist metrics is ambient_class. The induced-transience probe (below) is NOT part of the ambient ladder.
sweep_protocol.induced_transience_probe: Executed ONCE, AFTER the 1800 s rung. For each endpoint in stratum_stress: a fresh cookie jar, then a burst of B_stress=8 GETs at gap 0.15 s; record each class; load_class = max severity_rank over the 8. Then, for that endpoint, single cold probes (fresh jar) at nominal delays 2, 5, 15, 60, 180 s after the burst; record the recovery series.
sweep_protocol.request_headers: Frozen User-Agent 'SPIDER-research2/1.0 (+credential-free access-state persistence probe)' and Accept: */*; HTTP GET only; no authentication; no JavaScript.

request_policy.note: No retry, so a DNS/connect/TLS/timeout failure is directly TRANSPORT_ERROR. The per_host_requests=2 oracle controls are two independent observations, not retries.

sweep_protocol.partial_ladder_rule: Analysis labels each sweep by its NOMINAL rung; per-rung metrics use nominal rungs. Actual elapsed deltas are recorded and reported. If the anchor fails entirely, or the delta_ref sweep actual delta < 1500 s, or fewer than 3 T0 intrinsic / 3 T0 barrier endpoints are observed, the run is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

stratum_stress.definition: Fixed pre-registered rate-limit-capable set inherited from parent accepted evidence and confirmed by the pre-freeze census; NOT selected from this run's outcomes.

stratum_intrinsic_candidates.definition: Fixed pre-registered towards-persistent candidates from parent accepted evidence and the pre-freeze census; reported as a diagnostic subgroup, NOT selected from this run's outcomes.

strata.primary_inference_population: The full frozen 57-endpoint pool for STATIONARITY_SKILL and the intrinsic denylist; STATIONARITY_SKILL_NO_STRESS on the 52 non-stress endpoints is the pre-registered robustness replica.

decision_rule.metric_definition: STATIONARITY_SKILL(delta) = plug-in mutual information I(B_T0; B_delta) in nats over the binary barrier indicator (B = 1 iff ambient_class is in barrier_set), with a B_EXCHANGE global endpoint-permutation p-value (10000 permutations) and an endpoint-clustered bootstrap 95% CI [LO,HI] (10000 resamples). Higher = the anchor barrier state carries more information about the lag barrier state.

primary_decision_quantities.INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT: (n_t0_intrinsic >= 3) AND for every intrinsic class c in {BLOCK_403_CHALLENGE, TRANSPORT_ERROR} present at T0: CLASS_PERSISTENCE[c] at delta_ref >= 0.80.
primary_decision_quantities.DENYLIST_INTRINSIC_VALID: DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT(delta_ref) <= 0.20 AND DENYLIST_FALSE_REJECT(delta_ref) <= 0.20, both computed on the intrinsic set only.
primary_decision_quantities.STAT_SIG: STATIONARITY_SKILL(delta_ref) >= 0.05 AND B_EXCHANGE permutation p < 0.05 AND clustered CI lower > 0.
primary_decision_quantities.CLASS_CONDITIONAL_TRANSIENCE: RATE_RECOVERY_n > 0 OR RATE_ONSET_n > 0 OR AMBIENT_RATE_ONSET_n > 0 OR AMBIENT_RATE_RECOVERY_n > 0; reported as a refinement of the primary disposition, never as a pre-empting branch.

secondary_quantities.STATIONARITY_SKILL_NO_STRESS: STATIONARITY_SKILL(delta_ref) restricted to the 52 non-stressed endpoints, with its own permutation p.
secondary_quantities.CLASS_PERSISTENCE: Per T0 ambient class, the fraction of endpoints with that class at T0 that have the identical class at delta_ref.
secondary_quantities.INTRINSIC_PERSISTENCE: Pooled fraction of T0 intrinsic endpoints whose delta_ref ambient class equals their T0 class.
secondary_quantities.DENYLIST_FALSE_ACCEPT / DENYLIST_FALSE_R: Intrinsic-set false-accept and false-reject fractions at delta_ref (see falsifier).
secondary_quantities.ANYBARRIER_FALSE_ACCEPT: Fraction of T0 barrier_set endpoints that are non-barrier at delta_ref (the cost of a naive pooled denylist that includes rate-limits).
secondary_quantities.DENYLIST_HORIZON: The largest contiguous prefix of rungs over which DENYLIST_INTRINSIC_VALID holds; 0 if invalid at the first rung; censored at 1800 s.
secondary_quantities.DENYLIST_SKILL: log-loss improvement (nats/endpoint) of the anchor intrinsic-transfer predictor over B_CONSTANT_USABLE at delta_ref.
secondary_quantities.RATE_ONSET_n: Number of stratum_stress endpoints with a load_class in barrier_set containing RATE_LIMIT_429 whose T0 ambient class was not RATE_LIMIT_429.
secondary_quantities.RATE_RECOVERY_n: Number of stratum_stress endpoints whose induced load produced a RATE_LIMIT_429 and whose 60 s recovery probe is non-429.
secondary_quantities.RATE_RECOVERY_HALF_LIFE: Per induced endpoint, the first recovery-probe delay at which the class is non-429; median across endpoints; right-censored at 180 s.
secondary_quantities.AMBIENT_RATE_ONSET_n / AMBIENT_RATE_RECO: Ambient RATE_LIMIT_429 appearances (T0 non-429 -> later rung 429) and clearances (T0 429 -> later rung non-429) across the ladder.
secondary_quantities.STATIONARITY_SKILL_NO_STRESS_TREND: Two-sided trend of ambient barrier prevalence across rungs for the 52 non-stress endpoints.
secondary_quantities.n_t0_intrinsic / n_t0_barrier / f_b_obs: Anchor counts and anchor barrier prevalence, for reporting and power diagnostics.

branch_precedence: 1. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any measurement_validity prerequisite fails (network unreachable to universe or oracle hosts; classifier not reproducible; PC power < 0.80; NC false-positive > 0.05; an oracle misclassified; fewer than 3 T0 ambient intrinsic endpoints; fewer than 3 T0 ambient barrier endpoints; anchor incomplete or delta_ref actual delta < 1500 s).
2. S1_STATIONARY if INTRINSIC_PERSISTENT AND DENYLIST_INTRINSIC_VALID AND STAT_SIG.
3. S0_NON_STATIONARY otherwise, with the positive change class reported among {intrinsic_break, intrinsic_denylist_violation, no_anchor_information}.
MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reserved exclusively for prerequisite/control failure and MUST NOT be reported as S0_NON_STATIONARY.
decision_rule.measurement_invalid_conditions: Network unreachable; classifier non-reproducible; PC power < 0.80; NC false-positive > 0.05; an oracle misclassified; fewer than 3 T0 ambient intrinsic endpoints; fewer than 3 T0 ambient barrier endpoints; anchor incomplete or delta_ref actual delta < 1500 s. The absence of a load-induced RATE_LIMIT_429 endpoint is NOT listed here: it is a secondary-diagnostic absence that leaves the primary S1/S0 decision evaluable. These are attainability/measurement failures, not scientific results.
decision_rule.claim_ceiling: At most C-WEB-DYNAMICS = HYPOTHESIS here. H0/S0 and H2 bound (do not reject) a pooled static-denylist prior on this frozen pool/window and one vantage. No PRODUCT_CORE promotion; no EXPERIMENTAL upgrade from this single window ladder.

product_consequence_positive: If S1_STATIONARY holds: a static intrinsic-access-denylist built at one window remains valid through the tested horizon (>= 1800 s, right-censored by the protocol) on this pool, so the dead-end policy can use the measured DENYLIST_HORIZON as a quantified re-probe interval and adopt POLICY_STATIC_DENYLIST_INTRINSIC. If CLASS_CONDITIONAL_TRANSIENCE also holds, adopt POLICY_CLASS_CONDITIONAL_DENYLIST: deny persistently-intrinsic endpoints and apply a short cool-down (from RATE_RECOVERY_HALF_LIFE) to RATE_LIMIT_429 endpoints instead of denying them.
product_consequence_negative: If S0_NON_STATIONARY, the endpoint intrinsic access decision is not amortizable through delta_ref on this pool/vantage: the dead-end policy must re-observe before relying on a cached per-endpoint decision, and no long static denylist horizon is licensed. Either way the finding is bounded to this frozen pool, one network vantage and one window, and bounds (does not close) the timescale axis of C-WEB-DYNAMICS.

estimated_cost.http_requests_breakdown: 4 ambient sweeps x 57 = 228; induced probe 5 x (8 burst + 5 recovery) = 65; oracle controls 7 hosts x ~1-2 = ~10; total ~303; no retries

expected_information_gain: High and decision-changing. First falsification-first measurement on the frozen pool of ENDPOINT access-barrier persistence across separated windows rather than next-request classification. It produces the two quantities the dead-end policy currently assumes: a measured intrinsic-denylist validity horizon with FALSE_ACCEPT/FALSE_REJECT curves, plus class-conditional rate-limit transience. Both S1 and S0 are decision-relevant (static denylist horizon vs re-observe-before-use), and S0 is positive change evidence decoupled from mere MI non-significance.

scope_boundaries: Credential-free public HTTP GET only; no authentication, JavaScript, DOM, SPA, GraphQL or WebSocket.
One stdlib-HTTP client, one User-Agent, one network egress vantage and one ~45-minute collection window; the source-vantage axis is NOT varied and is a declared scope boundary.
The frozen 57-endpoint universe is used unchanged and is NOT extended; no post-outcome substitution or dropping.
No LLM calls, no browser, no credentials, no numpy dependency.
Persistence and denylist validity are tested only through the frozen intrinsic classifier and the frozen ambient/induced probes; the horizon is censored at delta_ref=1800 s.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Both two-sided branches are reachable through the exact frozen metric and branch logic, verified by a DESIGN-local offline calibration on synthetic worlds (no Web outcomes). S1_STATIONARY was selected by the EXACT frozen rule including the clustered-bootstrap CI-lower clause in 295/300 planted-stationary replications at per-class persistence rho=0.98 and 263/300 at rho=0.92; the full three-part STAT_SIG fired in 300/300 PC98 and 2/300 exchangeable replications (NC false-positive 0.0067). S0_NON_STATIONARY was selected in 300/300 intrinsic-break replications and 300/300 exchangeable replications. Thresholds are arithmetically attainable: with n_t0_intrinsic >= 3 and all intrinsic classes persisting, STATIONARITY_SKILL = H(B_T0) >= H(3/57) ~ 0.206 > 0.05 and the permutation p is < alpha under the PC calibration, so STAT_SIG follows from persistence; the intrinsic-denylist thresholds tolerate one recovery among 5 block endpoints (4/5=0.80) but not two. Precedence contains no reachability trap: S0's three evidence classes (intrinsic break, intrinsic-denylist violation, STAT_SIG false) are each independently producible (calibration rows above), and MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reserved for prerequisite/control failure only. The prior-draft trap (making the support branch require the absence of protocol-induced rate transients) is deliberately removed: RATE_* and AMBIENT_RATE_* are reported refinements and never gate a primary branch.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Prerequisites are stdlib Python 3.12 ONLY (numpy is NOT required or imported) plus live network to the frozen universe and oracle hosts.
